svg.title: Claude Ads: every ad account, one command line
svg.desc: Claude Ads covers 12 ad platforms with 33 skills and one /ads command. A command line types an audit for each platform in turn. It is read only by default and every finding is backed by evidence.
svg.text: 12 platforms, 33 skills, one /ads command. Read only by default,
and every finding is backed by evidence.

g.text: /ads audit google
google: search terms clean, 2 findings at medium confidence
/ads audit tiktok
tiktok: pixel firing, 1 finding at high confidence
/ads audit youtube
youtube: view window set, 3 checks unknown
/ads audit meta
meta: conversions API connected, 1 finding at high confidence
/ads audit linkedin
linkedin: audience overlap flagged, 2 findings at medium confidence
/ads audit microsoft
microsoft: UET tag present, 1 check not applicable
/ads audit apple
apple: match types reviewed, 2 findings at low confidence
/ads audit amazon
amazon: campaign naming consistent, 1 finding at medium confidence
/ads audit reddit
reddit: conversion events mapped, 2 checks unknown
/ads audit pinterest
pinterest: tag coverage partial, 1 finding at medium confidence
/ads audit snapchat
snapchat: pixel events verified, no findings
/ads audit x
x: conversion tracking missing, 1 finding at high confidence

svg.text: MIT licensed / 12 ad platforms / 33 skills / read only by default
